targets.title: Midnolin is a novel regulator of parkin expression and is associated with Parkinson’s Disease
targets.evidence_quote: From the molecular epidemiological point of view, it is necessary to replicate our results from the Yamagata cohort study in other populations. targets.outcome_quote: In this study, the molecular epidemiological results from a Yamagata cohort study were replicated in a British population cohort, regardless of racial and regional differences.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall replication verdict governs; the British cohort is a different sample.
